|extra_sections=== Published slip layouts ==
The 2008 slip moves Michael Bahr’s concept credit and the PC Volunteer Award credit from the side margins to the bottom of the text box. Both layouts have the same game text and stats.<ref name="pc-stinger-slip-layouts">Players Committee, Virtual Set 12, p. 5, slip 41, [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154830/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards12.pdf first sheet] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20090220144753/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/virtual/VirtualCards12.pdf 2008 sheet].</ref>
The earlier wiki entry used card ID <code>1112_41o</code>.
